The CM cone is one-dimensional in the Laplace-weight space; f* lives outside it, and its projection onto each a_n slot picks up a DIFFERENT contribution from the branch-point residue in (9). That is why the a_0, a_2, a_4 slots give inequivalent "outlier directions" for the same f*.
